name: Pact Beyond Death, Greater
body:
School necromancy [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 7, shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as pact beyond death but instead of raising the target as per the spell create undead the target is raised as per the greater create undead spell.
